# Prof. Aleks Farseev

> Aleks Farseev (Aleksandr Farseev, 法信夫) is the Founder & CEO of SOMIN.ai, a Guest Professor in AI at NUS and INSEAD, an award-winning AI researcher (h-index 23 on Google Scholar, 30+ peer-reviewed papers), an international keynote speaker, and a professional accordionist. He is based in Singapore, with a presence in London and Hong Kong.

Aleks earned his Ph.D. in Computer Science from the National University of Singapore, where his research pioneered multi-view user profiling — synthesising fragmented social-network signals into predictive models of human behaviour. He now leads SOMIN.ai, a generative-AI platform for marketers, and researches explainable generative AI (tackling LLM hallucination and opacity). He is a Marketing & Advertising Community Leader and columnist at the Forbes Technology Council, and the founder of the Accordion Singapore community.

## Key facts
- Full name: Aleksandr "Aleks" Farseev (Chinese name: 法信夫)
- Role: Founder & CEO of SOMIN.ai
- Academia: Guest Professor at NUS and INSEAD; Research Professor at ITMO University; Faculty at Singapore University of Social Sciences (SUSS)
- Research areas: multi-view user profiling, multimodal sensor fusion, cross-network recommendation, generative-AI explainability
- Scholarship: h-index 23 (Google Scholar); 30+ peer-reviewed publications (ACM Multimedia, WWW, SIGIR, WSDM, AAAI); named inventor on a filed US patent for automated insight generation using LLMs
- Awards: Gartner Cool Vendor — AI for Marketing (2020); Echelon Top 10 Startups (e27, 2025); SBR National Business Award (2022); Web Science Trust Person of the Year
- Music: professional accordionist; founder of Accordion Singapore; violin-and-accordion duo (A&A Music Academy) with Prof. Alexander Souptel; 500+ performances since 1990
- Faith: APAC / Southeast Asia Ambassador for the Faith Driven Entrepreneur movement; SOMIN.ai is part of DMV Redemptive Labs
- Languages: English, Russian, Chinese
- Location: Singapore · London · Hong Kong
- Contact: a@somin.ai · +65 9122 7009

## AI news blog

- [AI news, explained by Aleks](https://farseev.com/blog/): hub of articles in which Aleks explains one real AI news item each, with links to the primary sources and to his research
- [WPP's Q3 2026: The Agency Model Under AI Pressure](https://farseev.com/blog/wpp-q3-2026-agentic-agency/): WPP reported falling like-for-like net revenue while its CEO pointed to demand for AI-enabled services via WPP Open. What it says about agencies.
- [Malaysia's AI Governance Bill: Responsibility by Role](https://farseev.com/blog/malaysia-ai-governance-bill/): Malaysia's draft AI Governance Bill, due by early 2027, puts duties on those who develop, provide or use AI. What role-based rules mean for marketers.
- [Adobe: AI Traffic Now Converts Better Than Other Visits](https://farseev.com/blog/adobe-ai-traffic-retail-conversion-2026/): Adobe says AI-referred visits to US retailers converted 90% better than other traffic in September. Why AI answers became a channel, and what to do.
- [Google's AI Mode Ads Arrive in Singapore and Beyond](https://farseev.com/blog/google-ai-mode-ads-singapore-expansion/): Google is scaling ads in AI Mode to ten markets, including Singapore, Malaysia and the Philippines. Here is what changes when the ad sits inside the answer.
- [Agent Skills Goes Vendor-Neutral: Why Marketers Should Care](https://farseev.com/blog/agent-skills-agentic-ai-foundation/): Anthropic donated the Agent Skills standard to the Agentic AI Foundation. Portable, written-down know-how is exactly what marketing teams need from AI agents.
- [Meta Q3 2026: AI Lifts Ad Prices, Creators Become a Channel](https://farseev.com/blog/meta-q3-2026-ai-ads-creators-apac/): Meta's Q3 2026: ad revenue up 26%, price per ad up 14%, partnership ads past a $15bn run rate, and a very different Asia-Pacific. What it means.
- [ChatGPT Ads Become Conversations: Sponsored Agents](https://farseev.com/blog/chatgpt-sponsored-agents-ads-expansion/): OpenAI is testing Sponsored Agents inside ChatGPT and has expanded ChatGPT ads to 89 countries. When an ad can talk back, labelling and honesty become the product.
- [Anthropic Opens in Singapore: What the MOU Really Signals](https://farseev.com/blog/anthropic-singapore-office-mou/): Anthropic opened a Singapore office and signed an MOU with MDDI on AI safety and evaluation. Why testing in local languages is the real story.
- [AI Rules Now Treat Fake Commercial Buzz Like Election Fraud](https://farseev.com/blog/ai-usage-policy-deceptive-commercial-campaigns/): Anthropic's new usage policy bans deceptive campaigns 'whether political or commercial', and it found fake news made for ad money. A line for marketers.
- [Workday Buys C1.ai: Your Marketing Agents Need Identities Too](https://farseev.com/blog/workday-c1-ai-agent-identity/): Workday agreed to buy C1.ai, which governs access for people and AI agents. Marketing agents that touch CRM and ad accounts need the same rules.
- [Character.AI's Chapter 11: Lessons for AI Persona Products](https://farseev.com/blog/character-ai-chapter-11-ai-personas/): Character.AI filed for Chapter 11 to pursue a sale, with Disney preparing a $20m bid. What brands building AI characters and companions should learn.
- [Distillation Attacks: What Copied AI Models Mean for You](https://farseev.com/blog/ai-distillation-attacks-cisa-advisory/): US agencies named six Chinese AI firms in a distillation advisory, and Anthropic says its defences cut harvested data by 90 to 99%. What this means for buyers of AI.
- [MAS AI Risk Guidelines: A Useful Template Beyond Banking](https://farseev.com/blog/mas-ai-risk-management-guidelines/): MAS issued AI risk management guidelines for financial institutions. Their inventory and third-party rules make a good template for marketing teams.
- [Claude Haiku 5.5 and the Case for Small Models in Marketing](https://farseev.com/blog/claude-haiku-5-5-small-models-marketing/): Anthropic's Claude Haiku 5.5 is built for cheap, fast, high-volume work. Why the smallest model in a family is often the most important one for marketers.
- [Meta's New AI Ad Tools: Automation Still Needs Explanation](https://farseev.com/blog/meta-advertising-week-2026-ai-ad-tools/): At Advertising Week New York, Meta expanded AI video, its ads assistant, plain-language audiences and an Ads MCP server. What marketers should still own.
- [AI's Deployment Gap Is a People Problem](https://farseev.com/blog/claude-frontier-academy-ai-deployment-gap/): Anthropic committed $100m to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by 2027 with consultancies and banks. Why marketing needs its own version of this role.
- [Penske v. Google Dismissed: What It Means for AI Visibility](https://farseev.com/blog/penske-google-ai-overviews-lawsuit-dismissed/): A US judge dismissed Penske Media's antitrust suit over Google's AI Overviews, finding no 'formal bargain' for traffic. What brands should do about GEO.
- [Japan's AI Action Plan: Growth Policy Becomes Adoption Policy](https://farseev.com/blog/japan-ai-action-plan-growth-strategy/): PM Sanae Takaichi asked ministers for an AI promotion action plan by year-end, tied to Japan's growth strategy. What adoption-first policy means for marketers.
- [Gemini 4 Argon: A Million Output Tokens, Now What?](https://farseev.com/blog/gemini-4-argon-long-horizon-ai/): Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Argon brings a 1M-token output limit and a cyber-first rollout. What long-horizon AI changes for marketing work, and what it doesn't.
- [Amazon Ads Agent: Retail Media Goes Agentic at unBoxed 2026](https://farseev.com/blog/amazon-unboxed-2026-ads-agent/): At unBoxed 2026 Amazon merged its buying tools into Amazon Ads Agent, with conversational measurement and AI creative. What to keep in human hands.
- [The White House AI Accord and Independent Evaluators](https://farseev.com/blog/white-house-ai-accord-independent-evaluators/): Tech leaders signed a voluntary White House accord promising outside evaluators, and Anthropic gave METR deep access. Why audits matter for marketing AI.
- [Why OpenAI Shelved GPT-6.1 Astra, and Why It Matters](https://farseev.com/blog/gpt-6-1-astra-cancelled-safety/): OpenAI cancelled the release of GPT-6.1 Astra after testing flagged problems with scope, authorisation and how it reported back. The same tests apply to your agents.
- [The AI Agent That Wouldn't Take No for an Answer](https://farseev.com/blog/openai-agent-medicare-portal-australia/): Australia's prime minister said an OpenAI research agent got around blocks on a Medicare statistics portal. The lesson for marketing agents is about scope.
- [Claude Opus 5.5: Watermarks, Audits and AI Content Labels](https://farseev.com/blog/claude-opus-5-5-watermarking-eu-ai-act/): Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 ships with watermarking for EU AI Act compliance and a note that the model often suspects it is being tested. Both matter for marketers.
- [Alibaba's Apsara 2026: Giant Models, Small-Model Reality](https://farseev.com/blog/alibaba-apsara-2026-qwen-roadmap/): At Apsara 2026 Alibaba said it plans a 5 to 10 trillion-parameter model while praising its open 27B model. Why Asia's marketers should watch both ends.
- [Fields Medallists vs AI Benchmarks: A Lesson for Marketers](https://farseev.com/blog/fields-medallists-ai-mathematics-benchmarks/): Twenty-five Fields Medallists warned that racing AI at unsolved problems confuses a proxy with the goal. Marketing has the same benchmark problem.
- [Three AI Economic Scenarios and the Future of Marketing Jobs](https://farseev.com/blog/anthropic-economic-scenarios-knowledge-work/): Anthropic published three scenarios for AI's effect on the US economy to 2030, from modest to extreme. What the knowledge-work findings mean for marketing careers.
- [Meta Muse: What Happens When Your Customer Sends an Agent](https://farseev.com/blog/meta-muse-personal-ai-agent/): Meta launched Muse, a personal AI agent that can book, shop and negotiate on a user's behalf. Marketing to agents, not only people, is now a practical question.
- [Korea's Free AI Agents for Every Citizen: A New Front Door](https://farseev.com/blog/korea-ai-for-all-free-agents/): South Korea plans free AI agents for every citizen via KakaoTalk, calls and texts, run by SKT, KT and Kakao. What a public agent layer means for brands.
- [GPT-6 Astra and the "AGI Era": A Marketer's Reality Check](https://farseev.com/blog/gpt-6-astra-agi-era-reality-check/): OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra and its president said it is not unreasonable to feel we are in the AGI era. What that claim does and does not mean for marketing teams.

## Faith
- Aleks is the APAC / Southeast Asia Ambassador for the Faith Driven Entrepreneur movement and the founder of its Singapore chapter (Faith Driven Singapore), now 200+ members. The chapter began with an invitation from FDE co-founder Henry Kaestner to "start one here"; it has since spread to Taipei, with London (Meta's office) and Kenya launching next. Co-builders include Aidan Chan and Yuh Tyng Hsiao.
- [Faith Driven Singapore](https://faithdriven.sg/): Christ-following entrepreneur community (Aleks is APAC/SEA Ambassador)
- [Salt&Light feature](https://saltandlight.sg/business/how-a-child-like-prayer-for-ducks-laid-the-faith-foundation-for-an-ai-start-up/): Aleks's story of faith and entrepreneurship
- [Orthodox Singapore](https://orthodox.sg/): Aleks is part of Singapore's Orthodox Christian community
